liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (1 review): Opening Shakedown Street makes the listener move, indicating a tight performance [28]
- **Feel Like a Stranger** (1 review): Brent appears sick during Stranger, utilizing trippy effects and multiple keyboards [31]
- **Ship of Fools** (1 review): Ship of Fools, He's Gone, and Little Star are highlighted as good performances [27]

## The recordings

- **gd1983-04-15.138067.mtx.dusborne.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 173 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd1983-04-15.163649.senn441.neumann.u87.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 182 min [2]
- **gd1983-04-15.fob.miller.94283.sbeok.flac24**: source not stated; 22 songs; 172 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [13]
- **gd1983-04-15.senn421.coyotte.muletaper.88659.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 164 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [16]
- **gd83-04-15s2.sbd.dodd.9975.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 14 songs; 104 min; rated 4.27/5 by 11 [23]. Said about its sound: Soundboard recording lacks hiss or Dolby artifacts, resembling old PCM tape quality; Recording features crisp balance, prominent vocals, and strong bass without being overblown [26][27]

## Around the show

- Listener drove from Kent State to Buffalo to pick up friends for the Rochester show [24]
- Listener drove from Kent State to Buffalo to pick up friends for the Rochester show [25]
- Listener attended the show and notes the War Memorial venue may no longer exist [28]
- War Memorial was renovated into Blue Cross Arena, improving acoustics over the old hockey barn [32]
- Listener suffered severe stage fright and hallucinations while traveling to the concert with strangers [33]
- Recorded fifteen feet in front of soundboard, ten feet right; first show this user taped [13]
- Bob Star performance is inferior to the Meadowlands version, which included Other One [26]
- First set is unremarkable, though the second set improves significantly [30]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1983-04-15.138067.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Dave Usborne; source: 2 source matrix by Dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:32780), Recording Info: set 1: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Reel -> Dat (48k)Set 2: SBD -> PCM -> Dat… [1]. Also: Setlist includes Shakedown Street through It's All Over Now, Baby Blue as the encore [1]
- **gd1983-04-15.163649.senn441.neumann.u87.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Rob Eaton, Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Rob Eaton's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; (2) Sennheiser 441's (left + right) + (1) Neumann U87 (center) blend > Nakamichi 550 [2]. Also: Recording and transfer credited to Rob Eaton; coordination by Charlie Miller and Ernie Dodd; Audio Technica and Sennheiser 421 sources combined to patch Little Star through Drums [2]
- **gd1983-04-15.fob.miller.94283.sbeok.flac24**: taped by Charlie Miller; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Audio Technica Mics -> Cassette Master (Sony D6/Maxell UDXL-II/Dolby B) [13]. Also: Sennheiser 421 source transferred from cassette master to DAT, then CD, with Dolby decoding [13]
- **gd1983-04-15.senn421.coyotte.muletaper.88659.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Rick "Coyotte" Colyard; transferred by Muletaper; source: Sennheiser MD421's>Sony D5 (two maxell UD-XL2-S-Cassettes), Location: FOB-11th row DFC @6 ft high on stand (head high) [16]. Also: Tape flips noted between Rooster and Dire Wolf, and between He's Gone and Little Star [16]
- **gd83-04-15s2.sbd.dodd.9975.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>PCM>DAT>Sonic Solutions>CDR [23]
